description.zh: 杭州西湖是中国最著名的淡水湖之一，湖光山色与历史人文交相辉映。苏堤、白堤将湖面分割成数个区域，四季风景各异，是文人墨客吟咏千年的胜地。
description.en: West Lake in Hangzhou is one of China's most celebrated freshwater lakes. The Su and Bai Causeways divide its shimmering surface, creating distinct zones of beauty that have inspired poets for a thousand years.

zh: 西湖十景，四季皆有主题胜景
苏堤春晓、断桥残雪等千年诗意
湖区免费开放，周边寺庙众多
en: Ten classic West Lake views, each season unique
Su Causeway and Broken Bridge immortalised in poetry
Lakeside area free; numerous temples nearby

admission.zh: 湖区免费，景区内部分景点另收费
admission.en: Lakeside free; some inner attractions charge separately

tips.zh: 可租用自行车或乘游船游览，清晨湖面薄雾弥漫，景色最为迷人。
tips.en: Rent a bicycle or take a cruise boat. Early morning mist on the lake makes for the most atmospheric experience.
